thesis: The page is the aisle: every section is a numbered roll-up door along one corridor, and scrolling walks you from the kitchen-table reservation to the locked unit.

signature.name: unit door
signature.summary: Stencilled door numbers (A-100…A-110) top-left of each section with a track rule beneath; content reveals with a bottom-up clip mimicking the roll-up door rising.

motion.intro: The hero photo settles behind a left scrim while the headline lines mask-reveal upward, staggered 70ms; door number A-100 prints last. ≤1.2s.
stories: Truck icon drives down a pinned aisle line as seven move-in doors light up on scroll (desktop ≥640px); stacked cards with clip reveal on phone.
motion.hover: Hairline rule grows from left via scaleX(0→1), 200ms, consistent across buttons and card titles.
